response.reason: The implementation is a correct radix-2 DIF complex FFT of the packed real/imaginary halves followed by the standard real-FFT reconstruction; I verified the butterfly structure, bit-reversal indexing (position p holds X[reverse(p)]), the conjugate-based unpack formulas (xr/xi reduce correctly to E[k] + W·O[k], with the twiddle helper returning (cos, −sin)), the DC and Nyquist bins, and the quadrant-folded 65-entry cosine table covers all phases in [0,128). All arithmetic is done in float64 from exactly-converted fp16 inputs, so results fall well within the 1e-4+1e-6·|exact| tolerance after the fp32 cast, and the input storage is untouched with fresh output allocated.
